flags.label: Macro Stance
flags.text: Poland's case rests on domestic resilience, but the right expression is selective. The latest RPP decision described by Parkiet was a September rate reduction, while its newer assessment said NBP rates were and would remain above inflation, unlike deposit rates. [[n4214]] [[n4853]] September CPI remained below 3%, Bankier reported, and Strefa Inwestorów described inflation as within the target range. [[n4520]] [[n4518]] That gives easing a credible macro foundation without promising a straight path. The September PMI discussion at Bankier asked whether the apparent improvement really justified confidence. [[n4632]] August retail sales rose from a year earlier but fell from the previous month, per Money.pl, a clearer picture of a consumer recovery that still has friction. [[n4413]] Money.pl's latest GUS wage coverage focused on the pay level below which half of Poles earn; affordability should be judged against household budgets rather than a comfortable aggregate-growth story. [[n4596]]
